description: What is in the workspace, what it costs, and whether agents are reporting.

queries.name: Billable ingestion by table
queries.description: GB ingested per table: where the money is going.

queries.name: Daily billable ingestion
queries.description: Total GB per day to spot spikes.
kql: | summarize GB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1000, 2) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)

queries.name: Computers not reporting (Heartbeat)
queries.description: Agents whose last heartbeat is older than the threshold.
kql: | summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated), OSType = any(OSType), Category = any(Category) by Computer

queries.name: All agents with last heartbeat
queries.description: Every computer seen in the last 30 days and when it last reported.
kql: | summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated), OSType = any(OSType), Version = any(Version) by Computer

queries.name: Workspace operation warnings and errors
queries.description: Ingestion and data collection problems reported by the workspace itself.
kql: | project TimeGenerated, Category, Operation, Level, Detail
